# Carpe Diem Tours

> > European walking tours and cultural experiences specializing in Rome, Barcelona, London, and Florence with expert local guides.

Carpe Diem Tours offers small-group and private guided tours across major European cities, focusing on skip-the-line access to iconic landmarks like the Colosseum, Vatican, and Gaudí sites. The company combines historical education with culinary experiences, night tours, and underground explorations.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Rome
- Colosseum
- Roman Forum
- Pantheon
- Trevi Fountain
- Piazza Navona
- Barcelona
- Gothic Quarter
- Small-group tours
- Skip-the-line access
- Guided walking tours
- Food and culinary tours
- Night tours
- Private tours
- Cultural etiquette

## Rome Walking Tours

- [Wonders Of Rome Walking Tour](https://carpediemtours.com/rome/wonders-of-rome-walking-tour): 2-hour small group tour covering Rome's must-see sites: Pantheon, Trevi Fountain
- [Rome By Night Walking Tour](https://carpediemtours.com/rome/rome-night-walking-tour): Evening walking tour of Rome's landmarks: Pantheon, Trevi Fountain, Piazza Navona
- [Colosseum Express Arena Tour](https://carpediemtours.com/rome/colosseum-express-arena-tour): 90-minute Colosseum arena floor and Roman Forum tour with skip-the-line access
- [Rome Catacombs Tour](https://carpediemtours.com/rome/underground-catacombs-tour): Small group underground tour of Domitilla Catacombs with skip-the-line access

## Barcelona Tours

- [Barcelona Tours](https://carpediemtours.com/barcelona): Barcelona tour offerings: Gaudí sites, tapas, Gothic Quarter with local guides

## Private Tours & Experiences
